lcc_original: 蛇對女人說：『你一定不會死：
notes: UNV and LCC both render the infinitive absolute (H04191/WTH8800) as 一定, but the word order differs: UNV has 不一定死 while LCC has 一定不會死 — SNs follow LCC word order, so 一定<WH04191><WTH8800> precedes 不<WAH03808>.
LCC inserts 會 (modal auxiliary 'will') between 不 and 死 with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated.
LCC uses singular 你 vs UNV plural 你們; both derive from the same finite verb תְּמֻתוּן — no separate SN for 你 as the subject is embedded in the verb suffix.
Final closing punctuation follows LCC (：) rather than UNV (；).
